notes: Sapanca is 1.5 hours from Istanbul (by motorway or high-speed train to Arifiye). Get around the lake by car or bike. Maşukiye and Kartepe are 20 minutes away.
The Kartepe ski season runs from December to March; snow tyres are compulsory and the cable car closes in wind.
Trout, spread-style breakfast, ıslama köfte (in Adapazarı) and chestnuts are local specialities.
Bungalow stays are Sapanca's signature; they cost half as much on weekdays.
The Kartepe summit is 10°C cooler in summer, so bring a cardigan.
The lakeside walking path is 5 km long; morning mist makes for great photos.

stops.name: Lake Sapanca Walking Path
stops.tips: A 5 km lakeside walking and cycling path, with morning mist and greenery.

stops.name: Lake Sapanca Pier Cafe
stops.tips: Breakfast and coffee on the lake; Kırkpınar shore.

stops.name: Kırkpınar Beach
stops.tips: Winter lake and mist; a stroll along the shore.

stops.name: Sapanca Lake Fish Restaurant
stops.tips: Trout and carp from the lake, with lake views.

stops.name: Lake Sapanca Sunset Pier
stops.tips: Sunset on the western shore; great for photos.

stops.name: Maşukiye Waterfall
stops.tips: A stream and waterfall at the foot of Kartepe; a good walk.

stops.name: Maşukiye Trout Restaurant
stops.tips: Trout and breakfast over the stream, a Maşukiye classic.

stops.name: Maşukiye Village
stops.tips: Village square and market; walnuts, chestnuts, honey.

stops.name: Kartepe Cable Car
stops.tips: Cable car up to the ski resort; snow and sledding, ski pass extra.

backups.name: Kuzuyayla Nature Park
backups.tips: Forest and picnic spots on the road to Kartepe; an alternative to the cable car.

stops.name: Kartepe Ski Resort
stops.tips: Skiing (ski pass about 1,200 TL, equipment for hire); pistes are freshest in the morning.

stops.name: Kartepe Summit Restaurant
stops.tips: Sucuk ekmek (spicy sausage in bread) and mantı (Turkish dumplings) at the top, with views.

stops.name: Kartepe Hiking Trail
stops.tips: Forest trail around the summit; snow walks in winter.

stops.name: Sapanca Evening Bazaar
stops.tips: Stop at the bazaar on the way back for local products.

backups.name: Derbent Gardens
backups.tips: Garden cafes at the foot of Kartepe.

stops.name: Taraklı
stops.tips: 1 hour from Sapanca; Ottoman houses, Yunus Pasha Mosque, and a hilltop viewpoint.

stops.name: Taraklı Mansion Restaurant
stops.tips: Home cooking in a mansion; uhut (a local stew) and mantı.

stops.name: Taraklı Hot Springs
stops.tips: Thermal pool; ideal in winter.

stops.name: Adapazarı Bazaar
stops.tips: Stop in Adapazarı on the way back for ıslama köfte (sauce-soaked meatballs).

backups.name: Geyve Gorge
backups.tips: Sakarya River valley; scenery instead of the hot springs.

stops.name: Lake Poyrazlar
stops.tips: 40 minutes from Sapanca; a lake among sand dunes, with walking.

stops.name: Karasu Beach
stops.tips: Winter waves and a walk along the sand.

stops.name: Karasu Fish Restaurant
stops.tips: Black Sea fish and cornbread.

stops.name: Acarlar Floodplain Forest
stops.tips: Seasonally flooded forest; wooden boardwalk and birdlife.

backups.name: Karasu Pide Restaurant
backups.tips: Black Sea pide (Turkish flatbread with toppings).

stops.name: Sapanca Kırkpınar Garden Cafes
stops.tips: Spread-style breakfast in the garden; a Sapanca classic.

stops.name: Sapanca Cycling Tour
stops.tips: Rental bikes around the lake; 20 km of flat road.

stops.name: Sapanca Mahmudiye Village
stops.tips: The village of bungalows; forest and stream.

stops.name: Mahmudiye Forest Walk
stops.tips: Forest trail above the village; autumn colours.

days.theme: Lake morning and a gentle goodbye

stops.name: Lake Sapanca Morning Walk
stops.tips: One last walk along the lake.

stops.name: Sapanca Market
stops.tips: Friday market (otherwise the bazaar); honey, walnuts, chestnuts.

stops.name: Sapanca Seaside Breakfast Place
stops.tips: Farewell breakfast.

backups.name: Lake Sapanca Lakeside Tea Garden
backups.tips: Tea and toasted sandwiches by the lake; a farewell.
